newsitem.title: DUBAI: Lufthansa busiest airline at Sharjah in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa busiest airline at Sharjah in Dec.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG, an autonomous unit of Lufthansa AG, was by far the busiest operator at Sharjah airport in December, airport figures show.
There were 548 Lufthansa Cargo flight movements in the month. Condor Flugdienst GmbH, a unit of Lufthansa, recorded an additional 42 scheduled and two non-scheduled flight movements in the month.
Gulf Air was the second busiest carrier at Sharjah in December, with 225 scheduled and two non-scheduled movements.
Indian Airlines had a total 148 movements in December, Sharjah airport figures show.
There were 1,866 scheduled, and 564 non-scheduled flight movements in the month. Most of the chartered flights were operated by airlines from states of the former Soviet Union.
The most important destination for freight carried out of Sharjah was Moscow, with 3,422 tonnes in December.
Baku was another important destination for ex-Sharjah air cargo, absorbing some 871 tonnes in the month. Over 845 tonnes went to Tashkent in December. -- Hilary Gush, Dubai newsroom +9714-626990
